items.statement: The submitted workflow classifies intermediate B as a minimum and TS2 and TS2′ as first-order saddle points using harmonic frequencies.
items.expected: B has zero imaginary frequencies and each of TS2 and TS2′ has one imaginary frequency, or the submission transparently reports a bounded validation failure.

items.statement: The barrier comparison uses a common B reference and traceable, consistently defined Gibbs free energies.
items.expected: The report identifies the three structures, charge/multiplicity, method, solvent, units, convergence evidence, and computes candidate minus B without mixing state identities.

items.statement: The calculated barriers reproduce the source comparison for TS2 and TS2′ relative to B.
items.expected: The report gives barriers near the published values and states the unit and error/uncertainty honestly.

items.statement: The two cyclization barriers are separated substantially, with TS2 lower than TS2′ in the source model.
items.expected: The reported candidate-to-candidate difference has the correct sign and supports a lower TS2 pathway within the stated model scope.
